name: VARIANTS_EXAMPLE.md
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "example/variant-page", name: "VariantPage", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Choose page and component layouts independently.",
  defaultVariant: "standard",
  states: [StringState(name: "selected", default: "none")],
  variants: [
    Variant(id: "standard", label: "Standard", build: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
      Text(child: "Standard page"),
      Text(child: "Selected: ${state.selected}"),
      VariantCard(title: "First"),
      VariantCard(variant: "detailed", title: "Second", onChoose: SetState(state: "selected", value: "second")),
      VariantCard(variant: isMobile() ? "compact" : "detailed", title: "Conditional"),
    ])),
    Variant(id: "alternate", label: "Alternate", build: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
      Text(child: "Alternate page"),
      VariantCard(title: "Alternate"),
    ])),
  ],
)
